meta.title: WaveLog Bridge
meta.description: Sync TX-5DR frequency and mode to WaveLog, and tune the radio from WaveLog Bandmap clicks.
meta.readmeMarkdown:
# WaveLog Bridge for TX-5DR

基于 BI7ALG/tx5dr-waveloggate-plugin 2.1.0 修改。

- 频率、模式实时同步到 WaveLog，并定时发送心跳
- WaveLog Bandmap 点击切频（本地 HTTP 回调，默认 127.0.0.1:54321）
- FT8/FT4 模式下自动对齐标准拨号频率
- 全局单实例，多操作员不会重复上报

en.pluginDescription: Syncs TX-5DR radio frequency and mode to WaveLog in real time, and tunes the radio when a WaveLog Bandmap spot is clicked.
en.apiUrlDescription: Your own WaveLog address, e.g. https://log.example.com. /index.php/api/radio is appended if missing. Leave empty to disable reporting.
en.apiKeyDescription: Read/write key created in WaveLog under Admin → API.
en.radioNameDescription: Name shown in the WaveLog hardware interfaces list.
en.pollIntervalDescription: How often to check the radio for frequency and mode changes.
en.heartbeatDescription: Re-send the unchanged state at this interval so WaveLog keeps the radio active. 0 disables it.
en.callbackEnabledDescription: Listen locally for WaveLog tune callbacks.
en.callbackHostDescription: 127.0.0.1 by default (same computer only). Use 0.0.0.0 if the browser runs on another computer.
en.callbackPortDescription: Must match the port in the radio's CAT URL in WaveLog. Default 54321.
en.snapDigitalDialDescription: In FT8/FT4 mode, a spot within 0–3.5 kHz above a standard dial frequency tunes to that dial frequency (e.g. 14.074 MHz).

zh.pluginDescription: 将 TX-5DR 当前电台频率和模式实时同步到 WaveLog，并支持在 WaveLog Bandmap 中点击切频。
zh.apiUrlDescription: 填写你自己的 WaveLog 地址，例如 https://log.example.com。未包含接口路径时自动追加 /index.php/api/radio。留空则不上报。
zh.apiKeyDescription: WaveLog 中 Admin → API 生成的读写 Key。
zh.radioNameDescription: 在 WaveLog 硬件接口列表中显示的电台名称。
zh.pollIntervalDescription: 检查电台频率和模式变化的间隔。
zh.heartbeatDescription: 频率和模式不变时也按此间隔重新上报，防止 WaveLog 判定电台离线。填 0 关闭。
zh.callbackEnabledLabel: 启用 Bandmap 点击切频
zh.callbackEnabledDescription: 在本机监听 WaveLog 的切频回调请求。
zh.callbackHostDescription: 默认 127.0.0.1，仅本机浏览器可用。浏览器在其他电脑上时改为 0.0.0.0。
zh.callbackPortDescription: 需与 WaveLog 中该电台的 CAT URL 端口一致，默认 54321。
zh.snapDigitalDialLabel: FT8/FT4 自动对齐拨号频率
zh.snapDigitalDialDescription: 当前处于 FT8/FT4 模式时，点击的 Spot 若落在标准频点上方 0–3.5 kHz 内，则切到标准拨号频率（如 14.074 MHz）。
